subject: Harmonize orderform scope & term for Q4 capacity uplift
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <procurement@aptiva.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: Order form + term alignment for Q4 uplift

Hi Logan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re ready to move forward with the capacity uplift for Q4 but need to lock the term/ordering language before procurement signs. Attached is our latest order form (Aptiva_OrderForm_v2.xlsx) with the pricing and seat counts. Two quick asks from our side: 

- Can Redwood accept a 15-month term (starting Nov 1) instead of the 12-month box in the current MSA?
- We’d like explicit language for a partial-proration credit if we scale down within the first 90 days.

We’ve looped legal (legal@aptiva.com) on questions we expect will be redlined. Please confirm who on Redwood’s side will handle legal redlines and if you need any additional evidence (SLA excerpts, audit logs).

Attachment: Aptiva_OrderForm_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of Procurement
Aptiva Technologies

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <procurement@aptiva.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-21T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Order form + term alignment for Q4 uplift

Samantha —

Appreciate the attachment and the clear asks. Quick notes: 

- We can support 15 months but will need legal to sign off on the interplay with auto-renew language in the MSA.
- Partial-proration during onboarding window is something our finance/product teams have handled before; we’ll need to confirm the exact proration formula (days vs. token-based).

Looping in Jordan (contracts) and Kimberly (legal) to pick up the redline. Kimberly — see Aptiva’s attached order form and two asks above. Would you prefer we mark changes on the order form or propose an MSA addendum?

I’m available for a 30-minute sync tomorrow 10–10:30am PT if that helps speed sign-off.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <procurement@aptiva.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-23T14:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Order form + term alignment for Q4 uplift — redlines attached

Hi Samantha / Logan —

Thanks — I reviewed Aptiva_OrderForm_v2 and drafted redlines. I attached two files: 

- Aptiva_OrderForm_v2_redline.docx — tracked changes on the order form (pricing table, effective date and term block).
- MSA_Exhibit_C_proposed_changes.pdf — proposed short exhibit that governs prorations and scale-down credits during onboarding.

High-level position: 
- 15-month term: acceptable; we will reflect term start/renewal mechanics as: "Initial Term: Nov 1, 2027 — Jan 31, 2029 (15 months). Thereafter auto-renews for 12-month terms unless either party gives 60 days' written notice prior to renewal." This avoids a mismatch with our existing auto-renew clause.
- Proration: we can offer a 90-day onboarding proration credit but need to limit eligibility to material decreases (>=20% of committed capacity) to avoid gaming. Proposed language in Exhibit C section 1.2 (see attached).
- SLA credit interplay: any proration/credit shall be independent of SLA credits; we propose a carve-out sentence to avoid double-crediting.

Open items for Aptiva: 
1) Confirm whether Aptiva prefers a seat-count floor or a dollar-minimum floor for the 90-day proration eligibility.
2) Confirm whether billing will remain monthly or shift to quarter-in-advance for this uplift.

Next steps I suggest: 
- If Aptiva agrees to Exhibit C approach, Redwood will incorporate Exhibit C into the order form as an appendix and return a finalized packet for signature.
- If Aptiva prefers direct MSA edits instead, we’ll need a faster routing through our legal Ops (may add 2 business days).

Attachment: Aptiva_OrderForm_v2_redline.docx (docx)
Attachment: MSA_Exhibit_C_proposed_changes.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <procurement@aptiva.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-25T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Order form + term alignment for Q4 uplift — plan & sign path

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick turn, Kimberly; Samantha, appreciate the speed from Aptiva. Summary and next actions: 

Summary of agreed items (pending Aptiva confirmation):
- 15-month initial term (Nov 1, 2027 — Jan 31, 2029) with 60-day notice for renewals.
- 90-day onboarding proration credit subject to >=20% capacity reduction OR a $50k floor (Aptiva to confirm preference).
- Proration credit and SLA credits expressly non-cumulative in Exhibit C language.

Next steps:
1) Samantha — please confirm which eligibility floor you prefer (percentage or dollar).
2) On confirmation, Redwood will: incorporate Exhibit C into the order form, produce a final PDF set and send a DocuSign packet with the MSA signature path + order form appendix. Expect T+1 business day to generate final docs after confirmation.
3) Logan — please share the HubSpot deal link with Aptiva for internal visibility.

Links / evidence attached: 
- Draft redline (as Kimberly sent)
- DocuSign draft will be prepared once Aptiva returns the floor choice.

Samantha — if it helps, we can schedule a 15-minute legal quick-call tomorrow at 9am PT to close the floor question. Otherwise, confirming via email is fine.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Contracts Manager
Redwood Inference
